title: The Bascule/Pendular Maneuver: A Novel Repositioning Strategy for the Apogeotropic Variant of Posterior Canal BPPV.
authors: Asprella-Libonati G, Asprella-Libonati F, Lapacciana G, Gallipoli C, Gagliardi G, Guida A, Cavallaro G.
note: Bascule/Pendular 手法: PSC-BPPV 抗重力型(apogeotropic)的新型复位策略, 纯下跳性定位性眼震=短臂型/管-半规管转换(ac)假说的临床证据. 与用户 BPPV 领域(ac 假说, 短臂侧清除)直接相关, 可引.

data_provenance._note: 实验数值溯源台账 (P040a, 2026-09-07 reward-integrity), L0.5 凡数必源核对用
